coffees.name: 1615 West Giri (Light-Med)
coffees.roastLevel: Light-Med Roast (low air flow, stable burner & higher development)
coffees.tastingNotes: Fresh watermelon, orange liqueur and a tea-like hibiscus finish. Dry aroma: Red Berries & Jackfruit. Wet aroma: Red Apples & Orange. Fruit-forward & expressive with a dense, syrupy texture and rounded body.

coffees.name: Shevaroys Washed (Light-Med Roast)
coffees.process: Mechanically washed with fresh stream water, soaked for 48 hours, dried for 18 days, then hulled and polished
coffees.roastLevel: Light-Medium Roast (9-minute total roast time, variable drum speed and airflow)
coffees.tastingNotes: Ripe tropical fruit notes of plums & Green Grapes along with Pomegranates & cacao nibs finish. Additional descriptors: green kiwi, raw honey, spearmint lift; clean, crisp profile with bright acidity and medium-heavy body. Dry aroma: Berries & Plums. Wet aroma: Plum, Figs & Grapes.

coffees.name: THE YELLOW LOT
coffees.process: Anaerobic Fermented Naturals, hot washed followed by a rapid cold wash & eventually tumble mechanical dried at the farm
coffees.roastLevel: Above medium with high development ratio (17% development)
coffees.tastingNotes: Dry Aroma: Ripe Red berries. Wet Aroma: Jackfruit, Dates & milk chocolate. Cup Profile: Banana, Deep Date Sweetness along with milk chocolate and subtropical fruit finish. Deeply sweet cup, Crema Rich & Heavy Bodied with Lingering aftertaste & balanced acidity.

coffees.name: Pink Lemonade (Ultra-Light)
coffees.process: Sun-Dried Anaerobic Naturals with Raised Bed Drying
coffees.tastingNotes: Dry Aroma: Blueberries, Pineapples & Chocolate. Pre-crust Aroma: Dried Figs & Apples. Post-crust Aroma: Jackfruit, Nuts & Dates. Cup Profile: Vibrant citrus characters, layered with orange, green grape & red apple atop a sweet base of dried fig. Sweet, lively acidity with medium-heavy body and bright aromatic lift.

coffees.name: Cane and Lime (Light-Med Roast)
coffees.process: High altitude washed arabica dried on raised beds
coffees.roastLevel: Light-Medium Roast (14-15% development with high airflow)
coffees.tastingNotes: Dry Aroma: Dates & Chickoo. Pre-Crust Aroma: Cardamon, Green Grapes & Dates. Post-Crust Aroma: Chickoo, Milk Chocolate & Raisins. Cup Profile: Sweet lime & gooseberry brightness, layered over dense sugar-driven base of jaggery & sugarcane. Juicy mouthfeel with a medium body & bright, clean acidity.

coffees.name: MOGRA (Light Roast)
coffees.process: Anaerobic Fermented Naturals with culture microbes & mechanical dried at the farm
coffees.roastLevel: Light Roast (dropped with early 1st crack & 16% DTR)
coffees.tastingNotes: Dry Aroma: Jasmine Florals, Chocolate & Grapefruit. Wet Aroma: Jasmine, Vanilla & Forest Honey. Cup Profile: Intensely sweet cup with notes of Vanilla & Sweet Lime underpinning complex floral notes of Jasmine. Heavy floral aromatics followed by a well balanced cup & deep sweetness. BRIX: 24.2. Brewing recommendation: higher water temperatures (97°C) advised due to delicate roast level.

coffees.name: Summer in Kodaikanal (Light Roast)
coffees.process: Sun-dried naturals using controlled dehydrator drying
coffees.roastLevel: Light roast with high airflow and 14% development
coffees.tastingNotes: Mandarin brightness & rounded body that carries a lingering tropical fruit finish. Ripe strawberries with mandarin brightness, layered over gentle tropical fruit & soft cacao finish. Sweet, vibrant cup with bright acidity, a medium-heavy body & lingering sweetness. Harvest: 2026.

coffees.name: Coffee Drip bags (Med Roast)
coffees.process: Hand picked, controlled fermentation & slow sun-dried
coffees.roastLevel: Medium roast (208°C drop temperature, 15% DTR, 8.30 minute roast time)
coffees.tastingNotes: Ripe Blueberries along with rich milk chocolate notes in the finish. Syrupy mouthfeel and balanced acidity. Roaster notes mention blueberry and fruit candy-like dry aroma, berry-like wet aroma, and dense blueberry notes with balanced acidity and milk chocolate finish.

coffees.name: Raspberry in Loop
coffees.process: Anaerobic fermentation done in 3 stages for 72 hours, 48 hours and 24 hours consecutively, eventually sun-dried on raised beds
coffees.roastLevel: Medium roast with high development time ratio
coffees.tastingNotes: Dry Aroma: Pineapple, Mandarin & Cacao. Wet Aroma: Prune & Chocolate. Cup Profile: Natural lot with rich & ripe character of Raspberry backed up by round milk chocolate contrasted with a crisp & sweet mandarin acidity. Heavy bodied with deep rich tart sweetness. BRIX: 22. Part of "#2 Series - Roasters Art".

coffees.name: Roasters Espresso (Med Roast)
coffees.roastLevel: Medium Roast ("Slightly above Med Roast"); Low Temperature Fed with High DTR & Extended Maillard Phase; 10-minute roast duration on Probat VFD; 18% Development Ratio
coffees.tastingNotes: Dry Aroma: Hazelnut, Cacao & Dates. Wet Aroma: Almond, Berry Jam & Milk Chocolate. Sensory Evaluation: Almonds, Chocolate buttercream and Deep Sweetness from Ripe Red berries. Lower acidity, Well rounded Heavy Body with a base of sweet & creamy milk chocolate. Also referred to as "Roasters Art | Roasters Espresso 3.0".
coffees.availability: Sold out (707 listed in stock, but purchase shows Sold out)

coffees.name: Strawberry in Loop (Medium Roast)
coffees.roastLevel: Slightly above medium roast with 15-20% development time ratio and extended Maillard phase
coffees.tastingNotes: Dry Aroma: Red Berries, Peaches & Sugarcane. Wet Aroma: Berry Jam & Milk Chocolate. Sensory Profile: Milk Chocolate covered Strawberries with raspberry aftertaste. Fruity profile with round body and red berry finish. Serves as house blend at Grey Soul's Bandra, Mumbai location.
